A driver that declares `supports.zonedDateBucketing` (today PostgreSQL via `driver-sql`) buckets a zoned date in the database when the zone resolves to an area/location. On every other driver, and for a zone that resolves to none, the whole call still runs in memory. Keep the eval case for the sentence, or add one, and it must pass. Not in an epic.
